newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares set for new record, Novo in vanguard.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares set for new record, Novo in vanguard.

text.p: The Danish top-20 KFX share index looked set to hit a new all-time record closing high on Tuesday for the eleventh consecutive trading day.

At noon local time (1000GMT) Novo Nordisk led the field, up 15 crowns at 765. All in all eight KFX shares had climbed during morning trade with some top banks slipping due to profit-taking, dealers said.
Den Danske was unchanged at 742, rival Unidanmark put on one crown to 439, while BG Bank shed five crowns to 395.
The KFX top-20 index had gained 1.15 point to 187.25 at 1010 GMT, having closed 0.76 point higher on Monday.
